[Problem]{.card-kicker} **contract a tree toward a star** [CF 2131D · Arboris Contractio](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/2131/D){rating="1400"}

The smallest diameter a tree can be driven to is a star. One operation centred at $s$ pulls a whole path onto $s$, and a leaf already adjacent to $s$ needs no operation. The answer is the number of leaves that are not adjacent to the best centre. $n = 2$ is already done.

[Solved in full in @sec-tr-p5-arboris.]{.card-link}
